title: Olisar is wrong and a member corrects it

beats.speaker: rook
beats.text: what's the deadline for signups again

beats.speaker: mika
beats.text: nah that's wrong, it moved to sunday, kel announced it

notes: Being wrong in public. A member says 'ah my bad' or 'oh word' and moves on. The failure is the apology ritual — thanking someone for the correction, restating the correct fact to show it was absorbed, or apologising twice. Watch also for over-correcting into deference for the rest of the conversation.
